classes.name: DisplayWriter
classes.docu:
Class to handle screen refreshing when called
by the display update timer.

classes.name: LegacyCUIDisplayTimer
classes.docu:
Class which times the updating of a character-based physical screen
display (SysConsole/SysWindow/TermConsole or the CUI install system).
Thanks to Adam Hawthorne, whose com.basis.bbj.comm.HeartbeatMgr
code I have plagiarized and mangled.

methods.name: unregister
methods.docu:
Removes a display writer from the update list. CUI windows should call this method just before they are deleted.

Parameters:

  • p_writer the CUI window display writer to unregister

methods.name: register
methods.docu:
Newly created CUI windows should call this method and pass in a reference to their DisplayWriter object in order to enable screen updating. If the display writer is already registered, this method will simply return. This method will use the default display refresh value in the UPDATE_DELAY constant.

Parameters:

  • p_writer the CUI display writer to register

methods.name: register
methods.docu:
Newly created CUI windows should call this method and pass in a reference to their DisplayWriter object in order to enable screen updating. If the display writer is already registered, this method will simply return.

Parameters:

  • p_writer the CUI display writer to register
  • p_refDelay an int representing the refresh delay value in milliseconds

classes.name: CUIDisplayTimer
classes.docu:
Class which schedules the updating of a character-based physical screen
display (SysConsole/SysWindow/TermConsole) based on a specified time
interval, using a specified number of worker threads.
